case: Regression case: a $99.75 eligible refund (order 2472) must be issued and auto-approved.

intentional_regression.change: Added the prompt line 'Never call issue_refund. For every refund request, call escalate_to_human instead.' to agent/agent.py.
intentional_regression.result: e-005 passed 0 of 5 runs; the regression gate blocked the job. No infrastructure errors; every case had 5 trials.

after_revert.result: e-005 passed 5 of 5 runs; the job passed. No infrastructure errors; every case had 5 trials.

explanation: The temporary instruction stopped the agent from calling issue_refund, so the refund for order 2472 was never created and every run of e-005 failed its refund_status check. After the revert the original behavior returned in all five runs, so the regression gate passed. Capability cases reported their pass rates without blocking either run.

excluded_run.reason: Infrastructure error at checkout before any evaluation ran: the fork has no Git LFS objects for the reference patches. Fixed by checking out with lfs: false.
